Small, precise fix on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`, approved by Marcel.

**File:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/productCardFixtures.ts` — the `LiveSizeSelectionCard` component (read it in full first, including its own docblock, which already documents the exact problem this fixes).

**The problem, already diagnosed:** `LiveSizeSelectionCard`'s `useState<string | undefined>(undefined)` always starts with nothing selected, ignoring whatever `selectedSizeChipValue` the caller's `args` supplied. This breaks `../index.stories.tsx`'s `Wishlist` story (and its 4 `nodeCoverage` siblings), which deliberately pass `selectedSizeChipValue: 'm'` to match a specific Figma reference (there's a comment block on that story explaining exactly why) — they now render with nothing selected on load instead of `'m'`, until a chip is clicked.

**The fix:** seed the `useState` from `args.selectedSizeChipValue` when the caller supplied one, instead of hardcoding `undefined`. `selectedSizeChipValue` only exists on the `plp`/`wishlist` members of the `ZimmProductCardProps` union (same narrowing this component already does for `onSizeChipSelect` two lines below) — use a **lazy initializer** (`useState<string | undefined>(() => ...)`) that reads `args.variation === 'plp' || args.variation === 'wishlist' ? args.selectedSizeChipValue : undefined`, matching the pattern this same feature's `ZimmSizeChipGroup` already uses for its own mount-time-seeded state (`useState(() => computeFocusIndex(values, selectedValue))`) rather than a plain non-lazy initializer — read `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx` if you want to see that precedent directly.

This only changes the *initial* value on mount — it must not make the component re-sync to a later `args` change on rerender (that would be a different, larger behavioural change not asked for here; a plain `useState` lazy initializer only runs once, which is exactly what's wanted).

After the fix, delete the docblock paragraph starting "NOTE: this local state always initialises to `undefined`..." — it describes the exact problem this fix resolves, so once fixed it would be describing something no longer true. Don't add a new paragraph in its place explaining the fix in detail; the component's other existing docblock paragraphs already explain the overall purpose adequately, and one line in the `useState` call's own inline comment (if you want one) is enough.

**Do not touch** anything else in this file (the fixture data above it, the rest of the docblock, `createElement` usage) or any other file.

When done, report the exact before/after of the `useState` line and the docblock deletion, confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and confirm `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` (56 tests) still passes. Do not stage, do not commit.
